nom: Makari Kojic Acid Dark Spot Remover Soap Bars

avis.texte: I like how straightforward this soap is. With consistent use, I've seen real improvement in dark spots and overall brightness.
This soap has improved my overall complexion. My skin tone looks more uniform and feels smoother after each use.
I've been dealing with sun spots for a while and this soap has helped lighten them gradually. My skin looks more balanced now.
I added this soap to my skincare routine and it complements my other products well. My skin looks smoother and more even.
I expected something harsher, but this soap is surprisingly gentle. It still does a great job at improving the look of my skin tone.
After a few weeks of regular use, my skin looks clearer overall. It's helped reduce the appearance of uneven patches.
I mainly use this on specific dark areas and it's been effective. The spots are slowly fading and my skin tone looks more even.
I was worried it might dry out my skin, but it's actually pretty balanced. My skin feels clean and looks brighter without feeling tight.
I had a lot of leftover marks from breakouts and this soap has helped fade them over time. My skin looks clearer and more even now.
I've been using this soap on some old dark spots and I'm finally seeing them lighten. It's not overnight, but the progress is real and consistent.

avis.titre: Didn't remove dark spots after 1 month
avis.texte: I have cery minimal dark spots and im fair skin. Its soft to skin does not irritate but after a month of use i see no improvement
